_doc: Reference prompt (Glia seed reference_prompt): one master prompt, ported per model, rendered by bench/reference_run.py. pipe: comfy = morpheus.MODELS via /api/generate (the model's own quality prefix is added by the workflow, so it is not in the prompt), image = image_models.json via the Image Playground (prompt sent as-is), video = playground_models.json via the video Playground. negative: a string replaces the model default, '+text' appends to it, null = the pipe takes none. style: photo | anime | cartoon. Edit-only models (qwen_edit_2511, EDIT_MODELS) are left out on purpose.
aspect: portrait 7:9 (896x1152); each model renders at its native size of that aspect

master.prompt: High-fashion editorial medium shot of a young woman with sun-kissed skin standing center-frame in a rain-soaked forest. Right arm raised high, hand resting in her wet wavy blonde hair, left arm relaxed at her side. Body angled slightly toward camera. Direct gaze, lips softly parted, neutral-seductive expression. She wears a thin cream cotton romper with washed-out leopard print and a deep plunging neckline that teases her full natural breasts. Layered beaded bohemian necklaces and colorful woven bracelets on both wrists. Soft diffused daylight, rain droplets visible, gentle skin highlights, shallow depth of field melting the forest into a hazy backdrop. Photorealistic, cinematic flat color grading, washed tones, lifted blacks.
master.negative: nipples, text, logo, watermark, smile, tongue, exaggerated expression

video.master:
Subject: Picture 1 = first frame of Shot 1: young woman in a shallow forest stream, one arm raised, hand in wet blonde hair, leopard-print halter romper, layered beaded necklaces, beaded bracelets.
Summary: keyframe completion, starts exactly from Picture 1; slow, unhurried, sensual dance in the rainy stream, heavy-lidded teasing looks, minimal deliberate movement.
Retention: Picture 1 fully preserved (hair, romper, necklaces, bracelets, misty stream).
Look: natural, slightly desaturated, soft diffused light through rain haze, shallow depth of field, calm intimate mood.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): she slowly lowers the arm, tracing neck and collarbone; very slow fluid sway (hips rolling, weight shifting, shoulders barely moving); rain and ripples; heavy-lidded gaze at camera, chin lowered, lips parted, slow teasing smile on the exhale; hand down the thigh and back over the hip, palm along the waist, head falls back a little, wet hair clinging.
Shot 2 at 00:03: very slow push-in to close-up of face and upper body; subtle rhythmic sway; looks up through lashes, half-smile, two fingers along the lower lip, hand drifts to chest, holds the gaze.
Soundscape: steady soft rain on leaves and water, faint ripples from her shifts.
Music: sparse low-tempo ambient groove, soft bass pulses, muted percussion, steady, no swell.

ltx23.prompt: A young woman stands in a shallow forest stream in steady soft rain, one arm raised with her hand in her wet blonde hair, wearing a leopard-print halter romper, layered beaded necklaces and beaded bracelets, the misty forest soft and out of focus behind her in natural, slightly desaturated light. She slowly lowers her arm, her fingertips tracing down her neck and along her collarbone, while her hips roll in a very slow, fluid sway and her weight shifts from one leg to the other, her shoulders barely moving. Rain dimples the water around her legs and small ripples spread from her shifts. She looks into the camera with heavy-lidded eyes, chin lowered, lips parted, and a slow teasing smile forms as she exhales. Her hand slides down her thigh and back up over her hip, her palm gliding along her waist, and her head tips back a little, wet hair clinging to her shoulders. The camera then pushes in very slowly to a close-up of her face and upper body as she keeps a subtle rhythmic sway, looks up through her lashes with a half-smile, draws two fingers along her lower lip, lets her hand drift to her chest and holds the gaze. The sound is steady soft rain on leaves and water with faint ripples from her movements, under a sparse low-tempo ambient groove with soft bass pulses and muted percussion that stays steady without a swell.
ltx23.notes: LTX 2.3: one flowing present-tense paragraph, shots as time-ordered sentences, audio cues kept (it renders sound).

h3_10eros.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with wet wavy blonde hair, a leopard-print halter romper, layered beaded necklaces and beaded bracelets on both wrists.
<Subject 2> is the misty forest stream in <Picture 1>, shallow water among green trees under soft rain.

summary:
[keyframe completion] The target video starts exactly from <Picture 1> as its first frame. <Subject 1> performs a slow, unhurried, sensual dance in the rainy <Subject 2>, with heavy-lidded teasing looks and minimal deliberate movement, and ends in a close-up.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - her face, wet blonde hair, leopard-print romper, necklaces and bracelets are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the misty stream, rain and forest backdrop are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a natural, slightly desaturated look with soft diffused light through rain haze, shallow depth of field and a calm, intimate mood. At 0.00 seconds <Picture 1> is fully referenced as the first frame.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of <Subject 1> standing in <Subject 2>, one arm raised with her hand in her wet hair. She slowly lowers the arm, her fingertips tracing her neck and collarbone. Her hips roll in a very slow, fluid sway, her weight shifts from leg to leg and her shoulders barely move. Rain falls and small ripples spread around her legs. She gazes at the camera with heavy-lidded eyes, chin lowered, lips parted, and a slow teasing smile forms on the exhale. Her hand slides down her thigh and back over her hip, her palm gliding along her waist; her head falls back a little, wet hair clinging to her shoulders.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera pushes in very slowly to a close-up of the face and upper body of <Subject 1>, the woman in the leopard-print romper from Shot 1. She keeps a subtle rhythmic sway, looks up through her lashes with a half-smile, draws two fingers along her lower lip, lets her hand drift to her chest and holds the gaze until the final frame at 00:05.000.

overall_soundscape:
Steady soft rain on leaves and water, with faint ripples from her shifts, continues throughout.

non_diegetic_music:
A sparse low-tempo ambient groove with soft bass pulses and muted percussion plays steadily throughout, with no swell.
